items.body: TC-SM-STA-004: the seat map shows the feature word "Overwing seat(s)" on seats 16A–F and 17A–F. It is not on the sheet's list of expected feature words (Leg space seat, Window seat, Aisle seat, Exit and emergency exit). Reproduced in runs 017, 019 and 020 (four attempts). A person must decide whether the application or the sheet is wrong.
TC-PAH-004: after Pay And Book the booking and the passenger show "Booked", but the ticket number is NONE.
TC-PAH-003 is Inconclusive: the price did not change between Hold and payment, so the price-change behaviour could not be tested.
TC-SM-EXR-003 and TC-SM-EXR-004 are Inconclusive: no bookable "Exit and emergency exit" seat exists on the flight's map.
TC-HLD-005: the held booking keeps seat 2B, meal VGSW and bag 10 Kg, but the extras chosen before Hold total 2,824.00 against a costing amount of 2,675.50.

TC-SM-CNF-001 (Group 14 rerun): the quote was 14,989.50 but the confirmation Total Amount is 14,989 — the 0.50 is dropped, beyond the 0.11 tolerance. The same pattern appears in TC-PAH-002 on run 020 (7,829.50 shown, 7,829 charged). A person must decide whether this rounding is a defect.

Group 14: every booking with the infant-holding adult on seat 2B or 2C ended Failed (runs 019 and 020); on 2A (PNR JBZ2HG) and 3A (PNR OGMT3R) it was Confirmed. Same pattern as the recorded seat 5F refusal. Inferred, not confirmed: the airline's refusal reason was not captured. The rerun used settings.local.json infantHolderAvoidSeats [5F, 2B, 2C].
TC-RPT-002 is Inconclusive after the Group 14 rerun: the Statement report updates hourly and had not refreshed since the booking — recheck it.

TC-SM-MCT-005 (Group 15 rerun, PNR S8NTNP): totals agree (quote, confirmation and wallet drop all 26,862) and the meal shows on every page, but the 10 Kg bag is listed against the whole DEL-DXB journey and does not appear under its BOM→DXB flight on the itinerary. That journey connects via BOM (SG 603 + SG 5060). A person must decide whether the bag belongs to the journey (sheet wrong) or to a flight (application wrong).
